races.title: William Hill Epic Boosts EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A promising quartet. Expensive point recruit STICK TO THE BOARD appeals as the most likely winner following his encouraging second at Chepstow. Worcester maiden winner Black Eddy and hurdling newcomer Old Coast Road both look interesting in their own right. STICK TO THE BOARD (IRE) BLACK EDDY OLD COAST ROAD (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Old Coast Road (8/11), Stick To The Board (10/11), Black Eddy (11/10), Baron Du Brizais (5/1)

races.title: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: The pick of KADASTRAL 's novice hurdle form reads well (twice second behind one who finished runner-up in Grade 1 company) and having undergone a breathing operation following his Uttoxeter disappointment in the spring, Dan Skelton's 6-y-o firmly appeals as the type to do better now his attentions switch to larger obstacles. A pace duel won't help either C&D winner Sans Bruit or Javert Allen but both are too well handicapped to ignore. Conquer The Breeze is interesting at forecast longer odds. KADASTRAL (FR) SANS BRUIT (FR) JAVERT ALLEN (FR)

races.title: William Hill Molyneux Hurdle (Grade 2) (Formerly Registered As The Elite Hurdle) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Successful on 2 of his first 3 starts over hurdles (excuses when second here latterly), MYDADDYPADDY found further progress and shaped a shade better than the result too when an excellent third in the Supreme at Cheltenham in March. A notably nimble jumper, he remains open to improvement and is fancied to make a winning return. Alexei did nothing but improve throughout 2025/26, including when making the frame in Grade 1s on his final 2 starts and comfortably rates the lead threat. MYDADDYPADDY (IRE) ALEXEI (GER) MANGE TOUT (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Alexei (4/7), Mydaddypaddy (11/8), Mange Tout (4/1), Lucky Place (9/2), Melon (18/1)

races.title: Boodles Rising Stars Novices' Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Preference is for TALK TO THE MAN , who bettered his hurdles form at the first attempt sent chasing when winning a Worcester maiden in good style last month. He looks set to go on to better things over fences and can see off the challenge of No Drama This End , whose yard has a fine record in this race. Taurus Bay also appeals as the type to make a chaser and could be in the mix. TALK TO THE MAN (IRE) NO DRAMA THIS END (IRE) TAURUS BAY (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: No Drama This End (8/11), Talk To The Man (10/3), Favour And Fortune (11/2), Taurus Bay (13/2), Chanceawetmorning (12/1), Off The Jury (33/1)

races.title: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Several will have later-season targets in mind, and the vote goes to OUR GUIDE , who finished third in a strong renewal of Silver Trophy last month. Heather Honey is also fancied to go well with a run under her belt, while Lihyan needs a second look at bigger prices. Harbour Lake , Kikijo and Red Risk have all gone well fresh previously. OUR GUIDE (IRE) HEATHER HONEY LIHYAN (IRE)

races.title: Play Lucky Stable With William Hill Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: BOOMBAWN ended last season in better heart than his form figures would suggest and, having shaped well on return over hurdles at Chepstow 4 weeks ago, Dan Skelton's charge could well be ready to exploit his reduced chase mark with first-time cheekpieces enlisted. Knight of Allen often shaped well himself last season and is another on the shortlist, with C&D winner Imperial Saint and Southoftheborder completing the shortlist. BOOMBAWN (IRE) KNIGHT OF ALLEN (FR) IMPERIAL SAINT (FR)

races.title: William Hill Extra Places Every Day 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Little experience to go on, the vote going to AL CAPONY whose half-brother came to hand early in France as he won his first 2 starts over hurdles as a 3-y-o. Will Adam represents a yard which continues to go well and is next on the list, ahead of Nelouba who is the only one in the line-up with the benefit of a previous run. AL CAPONY (FR) WILL ADAM (IRE) NELOUBA (FR)
